//: Configuration for a library PC: the machine wired to the RFID reader. It relays the reader to the hosted site, so the kiosk at https://library.sma-techno.net/kiosk works. Copy to the install folder as appsettings.json and fill in the database password.

ConnectionStrings.//: The hosted database, so this PC needs no SQL Server of its own and shares one source of truth with the website. Replace YOUR_DB_PASSWORD with the database password from the myasp.net control panel.

Rfid.//: AutoDiscover means the reader is found on this PC’s own network, so its IP address never has to be configured or kept up to date. Host is only a first guess.

Bridge.//: Dials out to the hosted site and relays every read. Outbound, so no port forwarding and no static IP. The secret must match the RFID_BRIDGE_SECRET repository secret.

//Seeders: All off. This PC drives hardware; it must never reshape the catalogue or reset an account.
